description: List every database object (tables / views / procedures / functions / sequences / triggers / scheduled jobs) in a source SQL database — companion to database_replication for warehouse migration planning.

inputs.description: Reads database metadata via INFORMATION_SCHEMA / ALL_* / SYSCAT views

outputs.description: DataFrame with columns: object_type, schema_name, object_name, definition, row_count

database_type.description: Source database dialect: postgres / mysql / mssql / oracle / db2 / db2_iseries / snowflake / redshift. Use 'db2' for Db2 LUW / Cloud / Warehouse (catalog at SYSCAT.*); use 'db2_iseries' for Db2 for i / AS/400 / IBM i (catalog at QSYS2.*). Connect via db2_resource(system_type='iseries', library_list=[...]) for the i path.
database_type.label: Source Database Type

schemas.label: Schemas
schemas.description: Restrict inventory to these schemas (default: all non-system)

object_types.label: Object Types
object_types.description: Restrict to these object types (default: every type the dialect supports)

name: Database Schema Inventory
